findings.finding: Static cubemap background sampling recipe; no TIME/POSITION/uniform changes avoids needless sky radiance updates. Process mode only controls cubemap, not normal fragment execution.
Pinned GLES3 has actual cubemap boolean, derives world view direction, executes user sky code and applies tone-mapping color path.
ProceduralSky horizon weight pow(1-EYEDIR.y,.6/curve); larger curve expands neutral horizon band at low camera.

Sky and directional light shading derive direction toward source from light transform basis times local+Z. Static sky uniform is derived from actual SanctuaryKey local transform+Z; parent/root Sanctuary is identity.
